s.note: a villain who covers everything in gold
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and a pinch of curry powder until silky. Pipe back and finish each with a fleck of edible gold leaf.

s.note: the Miami Beach hotel where Bond first sees him playing cards
s.how: Poach 500g green prawns for 2 minutes, ice and peel. Mix 125ml tomato sauce with 1 tbsp horseradish, lemon and a dash of brandy. Serve over shredded iceberg in coupes.

m.how: Roast 1kg potatoes in beef dripping or oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear 4 sirloins hard and rest. Deglaze with 60ml bourbon and crushed pepper, add 125ml stock and 200ml cream and reduce.

w.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate. Stir smooth and chill 3 hours. Roll into balls, dust in cocoa, then roll in edible gold lustre until they shine.

d.note: Goldfinger offers Bond one at the farm
d.how: For each drink, gently press 8 mint leaves with 15ml sugar syrup in a metal cup. Add 60ml bourbon, pack with crushed ice and stir until the cup frosts. Top with a big mint sprig. Makes four.
